title: Fresh review-pr chain request and task inputs
description: An isolated authenticated gateway and checkout-local CLI prove the fresh-chain flag, persistence, predecessor exclusion and conflicting-request refusal. A separate manual task writer check proves the absence of prior-review input and instructions. No reviewer, product run or provider write occurs.

request-policy.intent: Create an isolated review request through the actual CLI and gateway, keep fresh selection on disk, reject inherited lineage and keep previous runs unchanged.

task-inputs.intent: Materialize the existing static review task without a previous-review file or instruction.
